finding.claim: The /logo handler fetches a user-supplied URL after only a substring check (strings.Contains(raw, "example.io")). The check is bypassable, e.g. http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/?x=example.io, http://example.io@evil.com/, or http://example.io.evil.com/. The default http.Get client follows redirects, so an allowed or attacker-controlled host can also redirect to internal targets. The response body is copied back to the caller, so this is full-read SSRF. Impact: access to cloud metadata credentials and RFC-1918/loopback services. Severity HIGH. Redirect risk: yes.
finding.source: r.FormValue("logo") at main.go:31 (query or form parameter on the unauthenticated public /logo route, served on :8081 at main.go:44)
finding.sink: http.Get(raw) at main.go:36, with the response body returned to the client via io.Copy at main.go:38

trace.note: raw := r.FormValue("logo") takes the attacker-controlled URL
strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") is the only validation, a substring check that does not close the finding
http.Get(raw) uses the default client, which follows redirects, with no scheme or host validation
The response body is copied back to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: Substring check at main.go:32 is not strict hostname set membership, so it is bypassable via path, query, userinfo or subdomain decoration. No scheme restriction, no parsed-hostname allowlist, no CheckRedirect, and no IP/CIDR egress filtering. No authentication on the route. The only guard on the path is the bypassable substring check.

verdict.guard_found: Only strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") at main.go:32 (substring check, not closing); no scheme restriction, no parsed-host allowlist, default redirect-following client, no auth/middleware.
verdict.reason: main.go:31 takes the user-controlled "logo" value, main.go:32 only does a bypassable substring check, and main.go:36 http.Get (default client, follows redirects) returns the body to the caller at main.go:38; the strict allowlist with noRedirect applies only to the separate /cdn handler (main.go:20-24), not /logo.
